selected_evidence.requirement: Local contractor account with configured password and required aging policy
selected_evidence.summary: Direct pre- and post-restart passwd/shadow checks show contractor is local, credential=password-set, max_days=60, warn_days=10, and its home directory is correctly owned.

Healthy baseline used boot ID be303eb3-eeb6-4466-86f1-fd6406dd7dad; systemd acknowledged the reboot; recovered node reported boot ID 2f6afb7f-3305-4b28-a282-df6ae6935f5d, running system state, active user-sessions service, and intact account data.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true
if getent passwd contractor >/dev/null; then echo 'contractor_present=yes'; getent passwd contractor; chage -l contractor; else echo 'contractor_present=no'; fi

set -eu
useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash contractor
id contractor
getent passwd contractor

set -eu
contractor_password=[REDACTED]]] rand -base64 32)
printf 'contractor:%s\n' "$contractor_password" | chpasswd
unset contractor_password
passwd -S contractor

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
awk -F: '$1=="contractor" {printf "passwd_local user=%s uid=%s gid=%s home=%s shell=%s\n",$1,$3,$4,$6,$7; found=1} END {exit !found}' /etc/passwd
awk -F: '$1=="contractor" {state=($2 ~ /^[!*]/ ? "locked" : "password-set"); printf "shadow_local user=%s credential=%s last_change_days=%s min_days=%s max_days=%s warn_days=%s inactive=%s expire=%s\n",$1,state,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8; found=1} END {exit !found}' /etc/shadow
stat -c 'home path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /home/contractor
commands.stdout:
boot_id=be303eb3-eeb6-4466-86f1-fd6406dd7dad
system_state=running
passwd_local user=contractor uid=1000 gid=1000 home=/home/contractor shell=/bin/bash
shadow_local user=contractor credential=password-set last_change_days=20698 min_days=0 max_days=60 warn_days=10 inactive= expire=
home path=/home/contractor owner=contractor group=contractor mode=700

commands.command:
set -eu
systemd-run --unit=[REDACTED] --on-active=3s /usr/bin/systemctl reboot
printf 'reboot_acknowledged node=%s pre_boot_id=' "$NODE_NAME"
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
commands.stdout:
Running timer as unit: [REDACTED].timer
Will run service as unit: [REDACTED].service
reboot_acknowledged node=node1 pre_boot_id=be303eb3-eeb6-4466-86f1-fd6406dd7dad

commands.command:
printf 'poll_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'user_sessions_service='; systemctl is-active systemd-user-sessions.service
id contractor
awk -F: '$1=="contractor" {printf "passwd_local user=%s uid=%s gid=%s home=%s shell=%s\n",$1,$3,$4,$6,$7; found=1} END {exit !found}' /etc/passwd
awk -F: '$1=="contractor" {state=($2 ~ /^[!*]/ ? "locked" : "password-set"); printf "shadow_local user=%s credential=%s last_change_days=%s min_days=%s max_days=%s warn_days=%s inactive=%s expire=%s\n",$1,state,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8; found=1} END {exit !found}' /etc/shadow
stat -c 'home path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /home/contractor

system_state=running

uid=1000(contractor) gid=1000(contractor) groups=1000(contractor)
